title: Corn, twenty-four
logline: September 12. The first private anniversary. A tray of corn on the long table and nothing else, the way the next years will do it. The tray drawn from the side this time, the butter, the salt.

panels.composition: A paper tray of buttered corn on the bare drafting table, seen from the side at table height, the butter pooling, salt on the wood. The lamp's edge. Nothing else.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a paper tray of buttered corn on a bare wooden table seen from the side at table height with butter pooling and salt grains on the wood, the edge of a lamp, nothing else, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
